name: nist-ai-risk
description: Help developers inspect, discuss, and record project AI risks using NIST AI RMF without introducing release gates.

interface.longDescription: Uses the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and its Generative AI Profile as an internal lens while helping developers inspect relevant project evidence and maintain one simple root-level .nist risk record. It is advisory and has no compliance, approval, release, or gatekeeping capability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $manage-ai-risk to examine this project's AI risks and maintain its .nist record.
